messages.2:
BRAM: I GAVE CORA THE SUN KEY.
I AM ABOUT TO CLOSE THE DESK.
YOU ASK ME TO WAIT FOR HER PAGE.
ASKING AFTER I CLOSE WILL BE TOO LATE.
messages.11:
CORA FETCHES THE PAGE. BRAM MAKES
HIS CLOSING ROUND. SHE RETURNS IT.
WHERE DID IT GO? ASK BOTH OF THEM.
8 NOW EXPLAINS THE DESK TIMING.
messages.12:
CORA TOOK THE PAGE USING THE KEY.
YOU EXPLAINED ITS RETURN BY CHECKING
HER RECEIPT AND BRAM AT THE DESK.
THE TIMING FITS. EXIT OPEN.
messages.13:
BRAM: I SEALED THE LEDGER BEFORE
CORA REACHED ME. HER PAGE WENT INTO
THE SEALED INBOX. ASKING ME TO WAIT
AFTERWARD CANNOT CHANGE THAT.
messages.14:
BRAM: YOU ASKED ME TO WAIT IN TIME.
I LEFT THE LEDGER OPEN ON MY ROUND.
I ACCEPTED HER PAGE BEFORE SEALING.
IT IS BACK IN THE LEDGER.
messages.15:
THE ORIGINAL ENTRY STILL IDENTIFIES
CORA. A RETURN DOES NOT ERASE IT.
ASK CORA AND BRAM WHERE THE PAGE WENT
DURING HIS CLOSING ROUND.
messages.16:
COMPARE BOTH CORA AND BRAM AGAIN
AFTER THE RETURN BEFORE CONCLUDING.
THEIR ACTIONS EXPLAIN THE TIMING.
messages.17:
CORA: I FETCHED THE PAGE AND WALKED
BACK AND OFFERED IT TO BRAM.
MY RECEIPT SAYS SEALED INBOX.
WHY WAS THE LEDGER ALREADY SHUT?
messages.18:
CORA: I FETCHED THE PAGE AND WALKED
BACK AND OFFERED IT TO BRAM.
MY RECEIPT SAYS LEDGER.
WHY WAS IT STILL OPEN FOR ME?
